passive.title: Report Card
passive.sample:
Your report card from Escuela Básica Cienfuegos came in. Overall grade: C+.

Mr. Medina wrote: "Participates well and turns work in on time."

passive.title: Rest in Peace
passive.sample:
The family dog, Bella, died at the age of 14.

They took their last breath curled up in their favorite spot.

passive.title: Season Over
passive.sample: The Barahona Rhinos Women finished 8th in the Women's Dominican Baseball League. Puerto Plata Rhinos Women won the title. I hit .268 with 23 home runs.

passive.title: Graduation
passive.sample: You graduated from Politécnico Gregorio Luperón! You graduated with honors!

passive.title: Debt Collectors
passive.sample: Collection agencies are hounding you over your $1,462 debt. You started answering the phone in a fake accent.

passive.title: Puberty
passive.sample: You grew eight centimeters over the school holidays and your moods have a mind of their own. Welcome to puberty!

passive.title: You're an Adult!
passive.sample: Happy 18th birthday! You're officially an adult. You can now get a full-time job, move out, sign contracts and make your own questionable decisions. You can legally drink now, too.

passive.title: Family Computer!
passive.sample:
Your dad came home with a Commodore Amiga 500 home computer ($4,700). It lives in the spare room. It has a hard drive with a whole 40 megabytes, a floppy drive and a beige case the size of a suitcase. There is a sign-up sheet on the fridge for computer time. Your name is on every line.

Activities › Computer is now open.

passive.title: Feeling Weak
passive.sample: You've been feeling terrible lately and you're running out of steam. You should really see a doctor.

passive.title: Special Talent
passive.sample: You aced a test meant for kids twice your age. Your teachers think you might be a genius! You have a special talent for academics.

passive.title: One Small Step
passive.sample: Your family huddled around the radio as an astronaut stepped onto the Moon. You tried to picture it in your head.

passive.title: Wedding Bells
passive.sample:
Your mother Leah got remarried to Eliyahu Mizrahi. Meet your new stepfather!

He brought a kid along: Yuval.

passive.title: Baby Brother!
passive.sample: Your mother gave birth to a baby boy named Liam. You're a big sister now!

passive.title: Baby Sister!
passive.sample: Your mother gave birth to a baby girl named Renata. You're a big sister now!

passive.title: Champions!
passive.sample: The FC Hanoi won the Vietnamese Premier League championship! I kept 12 clean sheets. You were doused in a cooler of sports drink.

passive.title: Divorce
passive.sample: Your parents are getting a divorce. You will have two birthday parties from now on, at least.

passive.title: Dumped
passive.sample:
Mildred broke up with you.

"It's not you, it's me." (It was you.)

passive.title: Lockdown
passive.sample: A coronavirus pandemic closed your school. Lessons moved to the kitchen table, and you only saw your friends from a distance.

passive.title: Retired
passive.sample: No team offered you a contract, so you retired after 14 seasons. The Barahona Rhinos Women held a ceremony in your honor.

passive.title: War at Home
passive.sample: The First Indochina War reached your doorstep. Your family kept its head down, stretched every meal and waited anxiously for news of loved ones.

passive.title: Diagnosis
passive.sample: Your mother took you to the doctor, who diagnosed you with polio. The treatment didn't work this time.

passive.title: Found
passive.sample: The police tracked down your hiding place and arrested you for draft evasion.

passive.title: Promotion
passive.sample: You've been promoted to Specialist! Your new salary is $18,700.

passive.title: Rejected
passive.sample: University of Taif School of Dentistry rejected your application. The committee didn't think you were the right fit this year.

passive.title: Tsunami
passive.sample: A massive tsunami struck the coasts of the Indian Ocean the day after Christmas. Your family was safe, but the whole country is grieving and helping the survivors.

outcome.title: Family Time
outcome.sample: You visited an art museum with your mother Yaritza. She loved it!

outcome.title: Bad Pet!
outcome.sample: You spent a week training Bella. It seems to be working!

outcome.title: Sibling Rivalry
outcome.sample: You told your mother Leah. Noga got in trouble and is now plotting revenge.

outcome.title: Charity Gala
outcome.sample: You gave $480 to the Whisker Haven Animal Rescue. It felt good.

outcome.title: Internet Diagnosis
outcome.sample: After three hours of searching symptoms online, you've concluded you have breast cancer, stomach cancer, and hepatitis A. Possibly all at once.

outcome.title: Medical Bills
outcome.sample: You gave your mother Yaritza $7,500. She hugged you so hard your back cracked. She is recovering well and telling every nurse about you.

outcome.title: Squabble
outcome.sample: You and Wanda squabbled over the last cookie. You won. Barely.

outcome.title: Cozy
outcome.sample: You lit candles and played board games by candlelight. Honestly, it was kind of nice.

outcome.title: Funeral
outcome.sample: You donated Yaritza's body to science. Somewhere, a medical student is very grateful. It's not what Yaritza wanted, and a few relatives made sure you knew it.

outcome.title: Hero
outcome.sample: You grabbed a stick and drove the dog away. The man is badly hurt, but alive thanks to you.

outcome.title: Looked away
outcome.sample: You looked the other way and kept walking. You will think about this for a long time.

outcome.title: Nostalgia
outcome.sample: You exchanged a few messages with Peter about old teachers who are definitely dead now.

outcome.title: Personal space
outcome.sample: You told them to get away from you. They saluted and ran off.

outcome.title: Responsible
outcome.sample: You dropped Pickles off at the shelter, where the owner showed up the next morning in tears.

outcome.title: Skeptic
outcome.sample: You said no. They looked at you with deep pity and whispered, "They're already here."

outcome.title: Snitch
outcome.sample: You told on the little boy. They got a time-out and you got your race car back.

outcome.title: Endorsement Deal
outcome.sample: You signed a 3-year deal to be the face of Blancpain luxury watches, worth $8,300 a year. Your first ad shoot involved a lot of slow-motion hair flipping.

outcome.title: Finders keepers
outcome.sample: You kept Bear. Somewhere, a family is putting up posters.

outcome.title: Generous
outcome.sample: You let the stranger have it. They looked very confused.

outcome.title: Mid-Life Crisis
outcome.sample: You took up the electric guitar. Your family thinks you've lost it, but you feel alive.

outcome.title: Polite
outcome.sample: You asked a street magician to please watch their language. They called you a nerd and walked off.

outcome.title: The truth is out there
outcome.sample: You said absolutely. They handed you a pamphlet and a tinfoil hat. You kept both.

outcome.title: You saved their life!
outcome.sample: You yanked her foot free and dove off the tracks with her as the train roared past. Hero!

outcome.title: Friendship unlocked
outcome.sample: You and Altagracia are now friends!

outcome.title: Long-Lost Family
outcome.sample: You gave your long-lost cousin from the other side of the family Vũ $2,500.

outcome.title: New friend!
outcome.sample: You and Eduardo are now friends!

outcome.title: Not my problem
outcome.sample: You left it where it was. Someone else will deal with it.

outcome.title: Off the grid
outcome.sample: You stayed home for a month and read every book in the house. It was actually kind of peaceful.

outcome.title: On hold
outcome.sample: You waited on hold with the power company for 3 hours. The power came back while you were on hold.

outcome.title: Re-signed
outcome.sample: You re-signed with the Barahona Rhinos Women for 1 year at $12,000 per year.
